tldr: Mars in the 1st house: drive becomes personal through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
body:
With Mars in the 1st house, this part of you pushes through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life. Mars describes drive, anger, courage, desire, defense, and the will to act. In practice, this brings attention to how you enter the room, respond first, take up space, and let the world meet you.

When this placement is supported, you can meet life with more self-trust and less need to explain yourself first. Mars can become courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters.

When it is strained, you may become overly focused on how you are seen, or push your body past what it is trying to tell you. The harder pattern can show up as reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear.
gift: courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters expressed through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
challenge: reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear around identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
